title: Spent coffee ground-derived biochar with trimodal porosity: green biochar supported highly dispersed TiO2 and Nb2O5 nanoparticles as an efficient novel catalyst for lactic acid synthesis
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SU00687B, Paper

Vlad A. Neacș, Maria Minodora Marin, Anca Dumitru, Cristina Elena Stavarache, Elena Olăreț, Erika Blânzeanu, Dana Culiță, Victor Fruth, Florica Papa, Marielle Huvé, Pascal Granger, Marian Nicolae Verziu
Trimodal porosity was generated in a spent coffee ground-derived biochar structure due to the synergistic effect between lanthanum and zinc, resulting in a lactic acid yield of 14% over 10% Ti–0.5% Nb/AC.
